parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use correct trigonometric formulae to form an equation in $\tan x$, for example $\dfrac{1-\tan^2x}{\tan x}+\dfrac3{\tan x}=5$. M1. Obtain a correct linear equation in any form, such as $1-\tan^2x+3=5\tan x$. A1. Reduce to a three-term quadratic, $\tan^2x+5\tan x-4=0$, or equivalent. A1. Solve the quadratic and obtain a value of $x$. DM1. Obtain $x=35.1^\circ$. A1. Obtain $x=99.9^\circ$ and no others in $(0^\circ,180^\circ)$. A1; ignore answers outside the interval; radians $(0.612,1.74)$ are treated as a misread. Alternative: use correct double-angle sine/cosine formulae, obtain $4\cos x/\sin x-\sin x/\cos x=5$, then the same quadratic and answers, for the same marks. Total 6.
